verdict.rationale: JumpCloud exposes a documented REST API (v2.0 spec at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml) supporting bulk operations on users/devices/groups, directory traversal, and a GitHub repo with API usage examples plus a PowerShell module — enough for programmatic/agentic automation. However, probes show standard discovery paths (llms.txt, openapi.json, swagger.json) return 404, suggesting the API isn't packaged for easy AI-agent discovery/consumption, and there's no explicit SDK or agent-oriented tooling beyond scripts/PowerShell. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path, first-party SDKs, and explicit AI/agent-facing API documentation or examples.
